name: @apelles/shell
description: Apelles app shell (D-039) — the window title bar (window chrome + the 3 tabs Edit/Motion/Colorist), a persisted tab store, Cmd/Ctrl+1/2/3 switching, and (D-051) the global Cmd/Ctrl+Z / Cmd/Ctrl+Y undo/redo keybinding over @apelles/history. Tab content is injected via a registry prop so the shell never imports the tab packages. Owns the app chrome, so it couples to Tauri.
